details: Taking the largest effective VC radius over projections is exactly VC dimension.
proof: If $S$ is VC-shattered, the projection to $S$ is the full cube on $S$, so its effective VC radius is $|S|$; hence $\mathrm{VCR}^p\ge\mathrm{VC}$.  Conversely, effective VC radius at least $d$ in a projection supplies a shattered $d$-set in that projection, and thus in the original class.  Hence $\mathrm{VCR}^p=\mathrm{VC}$.
name: Projected VC Radius / VC Dimension
